text: If you're embarrassed to take off your shirt because your back looks like this, don't use this remedy too often because it works faster than you expect. This mask helps cleanse the skin, eliminate wrinkles, soften stretch marks, and reduce scars. You only need four ingredients. Add to a bowl two tablespoons of instant coffee, two tablespoons of baking soda, one egg white, and two tablespoons of honey. Mix everything well until you get a uniform paste. Coffee activates circulation and drags away dead cells. Caffeine penetrates the skin, awakens tissues, and reduces the appearance of cellulite and stretch marks. Baking soda gently exfoliates and lightens dark spots. Egg white tightens the skin and lifts it, creating an immediate tightening effect. And honey deeply moisturizes and regenerates damaged tissue. Apply it to any area you want to improve. Back, arms, thighs, belly. Let it act for 20 to 30 minutes, then remove it with warm water. The skin feels softer, cleaner, and firmer from the first application. Do it twice a week. In a few weeks, scars are reduced. Stretch marks lighten and skin texture changes. But I want you to understand something, stretch marks. Scars that don't heal. And dull skin are not just a surface problem. In Chinese medicine, the skin reflects the state of the liver. When the liver is overloaded, the toxins it can't process come out through the skin. And what overloads the liver? Stress, emotions you keep silent, tension you accumulate. All of this is reflected in your skin. That's why there are people who use the best creams. And their skin stays the same. Because they take care of the outside. But what damages it is inside? Write in the comments, New skin. If you're going to prepare this. And if you want to care for your skin from where it really begins. I've been learning in silence for more than 20 years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile. Not only for it is in my profile.
